title: Banana Quest: a browser foraging game driven by the full FlyWire whole-brain connectome (with a Chinese knowledge base on fly connectomics and whole-brain emulation)
description: MIT applies to code only; FlyWire data CC BY-NC 4.0, MaleCNS data CC BY 4.0. Zero-dependency browser game in which a leaky integrate-and-fire network over the real FlyWire FAFB v783 connectome (139,255 neurons) drives a foraging fly, with an optional MaleCNS v1.0 mode (176,422 neurons, with VNC). Includes a technical note on normalization failure, structural readout bias, and tuning methodology on aggregated connectomes, plus a Chinese knowledge base on fly connectomics and whole-brain emulation.
notes: Game code MIT. Connectome data: FlyWire FAFB v783 CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); MaleCNS v1.0 CC BY 4.0. See game/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
